description: Mutate one work item. `action` is one of advance, approve_refinement, approve-and-route, move-initiative, dispatch, complete, update, reorder, archive, unarchive, close-as-fixed, reopen, mark-incident, drop, undrop, confirm-repo, assign, begin, dismiss-automation-suggestion, expedite, block, unblock, link-external, verification, add-evidence, remove-evidence, share-evidence, undefer, set-cycle, link-pull-request, unlink-pull-request, link-work-item, or unlink-work-item. Each action takes only its own fields: a field the action does not read is refused with 400 unsupported_fields, naming the field and the actions that do read it, and nothing is changed — so a success means every field you passed was applied. To move an item BACK (or between BACKLOG, REFINED and READY), send `status` with NO action: it takes BACKLOG, REFINED or READY, from one of those statuses or from work a person began (IN_PROGRESS with no crew) — the Console status menu's plain move, with the same role and initiative-steward rules, recorded in the item's history. Any other move is refused with 409 raw_status_not_allowed, naming allowedStatuses and the action to use instead (useAction): reopen for DONE, undrop for DROPPED, begin for IN_PROGRESS, complete for DONE, dispatch for a crew, drop; an item a crew carries moves with its crew. anyforge_get_work_item returns `nextActions.statusMoves`, the exact arguments for each move you may make now. Forward moves have their own actions too: advance, approve_refinement, begin, dispatch, complete. Use action='set-review' with inReview (true or false) to put work a person began (IN_PROGRESS, no crew) in or out of review; begin also takes inReview: true to start an item already in review. Use action='assign' with assigneeUid (a member uid or their email; anyforge_list_members lists both) to set the human executor. Use action='block' with blockReason (what the item is waiting on), blockCategory and optionally blockerOwnerUid (who is chasing it, uid or email) to mark an item blocked without changing its status; action='unblock' clears it. Use action='link-pull-request' with pullRequestUrl to show a GitHub pull request on the item, at any status (the Jira development panel). The pull request need not name the item; its state, title and reviewers are read from GitHub and kept current as it changes, and a linked pull request never moves the item. Pull requests that name the item by its code link themselves. action='unlink-pull-request' with the same URL removes one. Use action='link-work-item' with linkedWorkItemId (another work item's id in this workspace, from any initiative) and linkType 'relates_to' or 'duplicates' to connect two items; action='unlink-work-item' with the same two fields removes it. Both work at any status, DONE and DROPPED included, so finished work keeps its history; they change only the link and never move, block or unblock either item. relates_to has no direction. duplicates is directional: this item duplicates linkedWorkItemId (the original), which shows it as duplicated by; the reverse is refused with duplicate_link_direction_conflict until the existing link is removed. The link is written on both items, a repeat is a no-op, an item cannot link to itself, and each item holds at most 50 typed links. anyforge_get_work_item returns them as linkedWorkItems ({ id, type, direction, code, title, status }). A 'blocks' relationship is a dependency, not a typed link: set dependsOn on the blocked item with action='update' (refused with not_editable once a crew has started it or it is DONE or DROPPED). Before set-cycle, list the cycles of the item's team (team.id) with anyforge_list_cycles: it names the current cycle and which are locked. Use action='set-cycle' with committedCycleNumber (a cycle number on the item's own team cadence, or null for none) to plan the item into a delivery cycle. A locked or ended cycle, a cycle number beyond the cadence's planning horizon, and finished work are refused with the reason (409 cycle_locked, cycle_in_past, cycle_not_found with validFrom/validTo, item_finished); changing an agreed cycle is a scope change on the Cycles board. Use action='undefer' on an item deferred when its plan was approved (anyforge_approve_backlog deferItemIds): it clears the deferral and the item continues as an ordinary BACKLOG item. Until then advance, begin, a forward status change, dispatch and retry are refused with work_item_deferred. Use action='dispatch' on a READY item to launch a fresh crew (omit crewId; it returns { crewId }). Pass crewType and either runProfileId or runProfileOverride to choose models per role. The initiative must accept crews: it is in progress, or operator-planned (set operatorPlanned with anyforge_update_initiative or anyforge_create_initiative when you plan the work yourself and there is no Architect plan to approve). Otherwise dispatch is refused with initiative_plan_not_approved. Use action='approve-and-route' with targetInitiativeId (and optionally milestoneId) for a request sitting in a programme's Incoming Requests bucket: it approves the request AND moves it to the initiative that will deliver it, in one write. Nothing in that bucket can be dispatched, and advance / approve_refinement / a bare status change are all refused there with approve_and_route_required. It works ONLY on an item in such a bucket — it sets status to READY, so using it to re-home an ordinary item would promote that item past its refinement approval. To move an ORDINARY item to another initiative, use action='move-initiative' with targetInitiativeId: it changes the owning initiative and nothing else (same status, assignee and approvals), inherits the destination's codebase, and drops the pinned repo and milestone placement, which named the old initiative. It works at any status, IN_PROGRESS, DONE and DROPPED included, and keeps the item's pull requests, evidence and history; it is refused while the item's crew is still running (409 move_initiative_crew_running, naming the crew: halt it or let it finish first), on an archived item (move_initiative_requires_active) and on anything still in an Incoming Requests bucket (approve_and_route_required). Use action='confirm-repo' with confirmedInitiativeId instead when the point is to ANSWER the repository question — it both re-homes the item and clears repoUnconfirmed, which a plain move deliberately does not. Use action='drop' with optional droppedReason to remove an obsolete unfinished item from the active backlog; archive is only valid after the item is DONE or DROPPED, so an archive_requires_terminal response means drop it first. Dropping an IN_PROGRESS or IN_CREW item needs confirmActiveDrop: true (a drop halts the item's crew for good); without it the drop is refused with 409 active_drop_unconfirmed, naming the status and crew. Ask the person before you send it. action='undrop' restores a DROPPED item to the status it was dropped from (BACKLOG for older drops). Status changes, drop, undrop, archive, unarchive, reopen, close-as-fixed, complete, begin, advance, dispatch, expedite and move-initiative are limited to the initiative's operator, its program's lead or owner, members of its team, the item's assignee and company Owners (the person who dropped an item may also undrop it for 7 days); anyone else gets 403 forbidden_initiative_scope and nothing is written. Every drop, restore and archive is audited with the channel it came through. Use action='close-as-fixed' with closedReason for work fixed outside AnyForge, and optionally closedEvidenceUrls (up to 10 http(s) links to the commit, pull request or release that fixed it). Use action='link-external' with externalKey (and optionally externalUrl) to record where the same work lives in another tracker; externalKey null unlinks it. Use action='verification' with verificationState 'verified' to record that the client accepted a DONE item (it then locks), or null to stop tracking an unaccepted item; it requires a credential bound to a user (a personal key or OAuth grant) so the acceptance is attributable. Use action='add-evidence' with `evidence` to record a test run done outside AnyForge (for example a QA suite run against a sandbox) on the item, at any status; the result carries the new entry and its id. Entries are internal unless evidence.clientVisible is true. Use action='share-evidence' with evidenceId and clientVisible to share or unshare a reviewed entry. Use action='remove-evidence' with evidenceId to remove one; only its author or an owner may. anyforge_get_work_item returns the item's entries as `testEvidence`. When the item's program requires test evidence (anyforge_update_program testEvidenceRequired), action='complete' is refused with 409 test_evidence_required until the item has at least one entry of any result; add one with action='add-evidence' and complete again. close-as-fixed is not held by it. Labels (the Console's Labels field) are `tags`. Use action='update' with addTags and/or removeTags to change some labels: they apply to the labels stored at write time, need no revision, and are the way to relabel many items from a script. To replace the whole list, send tags with ifClassificationRevision, the item's classificationRevision from anyforge_get_work_item (a stale value is refused with 409 work_item_classification_modified). A labels-only update works at any status, DONE, DROPPED and archived included; other fields in the same call keep the normal edit rules. The result carries the item's labels and classificationRevision after the write. action='set-type' with type and action='set-due-date' with dueDate (yyyy-mm-dd, or null to clear) change only that field at ANY status, finished work included; action='update' refuses them once a crew has started. action='set-latest-status' with latestStatus (up to 1000 characters; null or "" clears it) writes the item's one-line current status, which clients read on shared reports; it works at any status, archived included. action='keep-listed' keeps an unarchived DONE or DROPPED item off the program's automatic archive until it finishes again. action='checklist' applies checklistOps (all or nothing, at most 50) to the item's checklist of small steps, with ifChecklistRevision set to the checklistRevision anyforge_get_work_item returned (0 when absent; a stale value is refused with 409 work_item_checklist_modified). Each op is one of { op: 'add', text, assigneeUid?, index? }, { op: 'edit', id, text }, { op: 'toggle', id, done }, { op: 'assign', id, assigneeUid | null }, { op: 'move', id, toIndex } or { op: 'remove', id }; a list holds at most 50 steps of 300 characters. action='checklist-promote' with checklistItemId and ifChecklistRevision turns one step into a sibling work item in the same initiative, linked relates_to, and removes the step. A dropped or archived item's checklist is read-only. Requires `write` scope.

action.description: The lifecycle or field mutation to apply. Leave it out only to send `status`.

addTags.description: For update: labels to add to the item's current labels. No revision needed. Labels are trimmed, lower-cased and deduplicated; at most 20 per item, 40 characters each. A label in one of the workspace's label groups replaces the item's other label from that group.

allowedWritePaths.description: File write scope: a hard boundary on the repository files the crew may change, as relative patterns (literal, * or **; [ and ] are literal characters, so src/pages/[slug].astro is a valid entry). null/omitted is unrestricted; [] is read-only. Any write scope also withholds connected (MCP) tools that can write; tools their server marks readOnlyHint stay. Set before dispatch; locked once crewId exists. To point the crew at a monorepo folder without restricting it, use folderScope.

architectPlan.description: For action='approve_refinement' only: the architect plan text recorded with the approval. action='update' does not take it.

assigneeUid.description: For assign/begin (and a checklist op's step owner, by uid, inside checklistOps): the human executor — a member uid or their email (anyforge_list_members lists both); null clears the assignee. assign works in any status, DONE included; only an archived item is refused. An unknown uid is refused as assignee_not_found, a person who is not an active member as assignee_not_member, a viewer or filer as assignee_role_not_eligible.

blockCategory.description: For action='block': what kind of blocker it is. Required.

blockReason.description: For action='block': what the item is waiting on. Required.

blockerOwnerUid.description: For action='block': who owns clearing the block — a member uid or their email (editor or above; anyforge_list_members lists them); null leaves it unowned.

branchName.description: For update: the branch this item's crew works on instead of the derived name. null or '' clears it back to the derived name. Takes effect at the next dispatch.

checklistItemId.description: For action='checklist-promote': the id of the checklist step to turn into a sibling work item.

checklistOps.description: For action='checklist': the operations to apply in order, all or nothing: { op: 'add', text, assigneeUid?, index? }, { op: 'edit', id, text }, { op: 'toggle', id, done }, { op: 'assign', id, assigneeUid | null }, { op: 'move', id, toIndex }, { op: 'remove', id }. Step ids come from the item's checklist.

clientVisible.description: For action='share-evidence': true shares the entry on client reports; false keeps it internal.

closedAsFixedByWorkItemId.description: For action='close-as-fixed': optional item that delivered the fix.

closedEvidenceUrls.description: For action='close-as-fixed': optional absolute http(s) links to evidence that the work is already fixed.

closedReason.description: For action='close-as-fixed': required explanation for the external fix.

committedCycleNumber.description: For action='set-cycle': the cycle to commit the item to, on its own team's cadence; null takes it out of every cycle.

confirmActiveDrop.description: For action='drop': true to drop an IN_PROGRESS or IN_CREW item (its crew is halted). Send only after the person confirmed; otherwise the drop is refused with active_drop_unconfirmed.

confirmedInitiativeId.description: For action='confirm-repo': initiative whose repository is confirmed.

crewId.description: For action='dispatch' — OPTIONAL: omit to mint a fresh crew; provide only to attach to an existing one.

crewType.description: For dispatch: the crew's type, a label (default roster and usage estimates). Every crew type runs the same Engineer-led crew and does not restrict which models run.

dependsOn.description: For update: work-item ids that must finish first (Jira's 'is blocked by'). Not editable once the item is DONE or DROPPED; record history there with link-work-item.

droppedReason.description: For action='drop': optional operator/agent reason retained on the DROPPED item.

dueDate.description: For update or set-due-date: ISO yyyy-mm-dd date; null clears it. set-due-date works at any status.

estimate.description: For update: the effort estimate as a person says it — "2h", "1.5d", "1w", or a number of days. Stored as operator-days, marked operator-entered; null clears it.

estimatePoints.description: For update: the point estimate on the point scale this workspace uses (a number, or a T-shirt size such as "M"); null clears it. Refused while the workspace estimates in time.

evidence.description: For action='add-evidence': one test run done outside AnyForge. Recorded against the key's user, or as an API key when the key is not bound to one. Secret-shaped text in summary/environment is redacted; a link carrying a credential is refused. Files (screenshots, PDFs, logs, video) attach to the entry itself in `files` as base64, at most 22 MB of files per call; larger ones go through POST …/work/{id}/evidence/uploads and are named in `uploadIds`. Limited by size, never by count: 25 MB per file and 100 MB per entry, and a batch over either limit is refused whole, saving nothing. SVG and HTML are refused. Files follow `clientVisible`.

casesFailed.description: Optional number of cases that failed.

casesPassed.description: Optional number of cases that passed.

clientVisible.description: Show this entry to the client on shared reports. Defaults to false (internal).

files.description: Files to attach to this entry, shown with it (images as thumbnails) and on the shared report when clientVisible is true.

mediaType.description: MIME type; the extension wins when they disagree.

name.description: File name with its extension, which decides the stored type.

links.description: Absolute http(s) links to the run, report or logs.

status.description: The outcome. Required. "passed" is refused when casesFailed > 0.

summary.description: What was tested and what happened. Required.

uploadIds.description: Ids of direct uploads already confirmed for this item (POST …/evidence/uploads, PUT the bytes, POST …/uploads/{uploadId}), for files too large to send as base64.

evidenceId.description: For action='remove-evidence' or 'share-evidence': the id of the evidence entry.

expedite.description: For action='expedite': true enters the expedite lane; false removes the lane flag.

externalKey.description: For action='link-external': the item's id in the other tracker (e.g. PROJ-42); null or "" unlinks it.

externalUrl.description: For action='link-external': optional http(s) link to the item in the other tracker.

folderScope.description: For update: the repository folder this item's work is in (for example apps/web): picks the crew's setup and which repository skills come first, and restricts nothing. null or '' clears it. Takes effect at the next dispatch.

ifChecklistRevision.description: For action='checklist' and 'checklist-promote': the item's checklistRevision as read with anyforge_get_work_item (0 when absent). Required.

ifClassificationRevision.description: For update: the item's classificationRevision as read with anyforge_get_work_item. Required with tags; optional with addTags/removeTags, where it is still checked.

inReview.description: For action='set-review': true puts work a person began in review, false takes it back to In progress. For action='begin': true starts the item already in review.

incident.description: Incident severity and impact metadata when the item is an incident.

latestStatus.description: For action='set-latest-status': the item's one-line current status, shown to clients on shared reports. Up to 1000 characters; null or "" clears it.

linkType.description: For action='link-work-item' / 'unlink-work-item': relates_to, or duplicates (this item duplicates linkedWorkItemId).

linkedWorkItemId.description: For action='link-work-item' / 'unlink-work-item': the id of the other work item in this workspace.

migrationStrategy.description: For update, migration only: copy, history-preserving, or subtree.

milestoneId.description: For action='approve-and-route': one of the TARGET initiative's existing milestone ids; omit or null to leave the item unplaced.

outOfScope.description: For update: bullet-list markdown of what this item explicitly does NOT cover; empty string clears it.

priority.description: For update: P0, P1, P2, P3, or none to clear it (no priority).

pullRequestUrl.description: For action='link-pull-request' / 'unlink-pull-request': the pull request link, https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}/pull/{number}.

removeTags.description: For update: labels to remove from the item's current labels; one it does not carry is ignored. No revision needed.

reportedMilestoneId.description: For update: the program milestone (wave) this was reported against; null or "" clears it. Must be a milestone id of the program that owns the item's initiative.

runProfileId.description: For dispatch: id of a saved crew run profile (Settings → Agents). Sets the provider and model for every crew role. Do not combine with runProfileOverride.

runProfileOverride.description: For dispatch: a one-off run configuration for this crew only, `{ roles: { SOFTWARE_ARCHITECT, FULL_STACK_ENGINEER, QA_REVIEWER, COMPLIANCE_SECURITY } }` where each role is `{ provider, model }`. All four roles are required (a missing one is refused with invalid_run_profile). provider is one of anthropic, openai, google, openrouter, vertex. The FULL_STACK_ENGINEER entry decides what the Engineer runs on; the other roles run when the Engineer consults them and in the review that follows a pull request the crew opened. Without a run profile, each role uses the company's Agents configuration. Do not combine with runProfileId.

sourceGithubBranch.description: For update, migration only: source branch to copy from.

sourceGithubRepo.description: For update, migration only: read-only source repository to copy from. The source fields and targetPath need it.

sourceGithubSha.description: For update, migration only: source commit to copy from.

sourcePath.description: For update, migration only: path in the source repository to copy.

status.description: Only with NO action: move the item to BACKLOG, REFINED or READY, from one of those or from work a person began (IN_PROGRESS, no crew). This is how an item moves back (READY to BACKLOG, In progress to Backlog). Refused with 409 raw_status_not_allowed from any other status, naming allowedStatuses and useAction.

tags.description: For update: replaces every label; [] clears them. Needs ifClassificationRevision. Not with addTags/removeTags. Labels are trimmed, lower-cased and deduplicated; at most 20 per item, 40 characters each. A label in one of the workspace's label groups replaces the item's other label from that group.

targetGithubRepo.description: For update: writable owner/name repository; null clears it where allowed. confirm-repo takes confirmedInitiativeId instead.

targetInitiativeId.description: For action='approve-and-route': the initiative that will DELIVER this request. For action='move-initiative': the initiative the item moves to. Required for both; must not be an Incoming Requests bucket.

targetPath.description: For update, migration only: where the copied source lands in the target repository. Not a working folder for ordinary work; use folderScope for that.

teamSlug.description: For update: the item's own team (an existing team's slug); null or "" clears it so the item inherits its initiative's team. Allowed at any status when sent alone. The item's own team also limits who may start a crew on it (its members, owners and operators). An owner or operator can always change it; an editor only when the item has no team of its own yet or they belong to that team (else 403 forbidden_team).

type.description: For update or set-type: BUG, FEATURE, ENHANCEMENT, KTLO, TECH_DEBT, or INCIDENT. set-type works at any status.

validationBranch.description: For update on an integration-validation item: validate this branch instead of waiting for every crew PR to merge. When it differs from the base branch, the validation run checks it out and accepts each crew PR whose head commit the branch already contains; closing the initiative still requires the merges. null or "" clears it.

verificationState.description: For action='verification': 'verified' when the client accepted a DONE item; null stops tracking an item that is not yet accepted.

name: anyforge_update_work_item
title: Update work item
